when_to_use: All clickable buttons and interactive elements

performance_note: Use transform-origin to match trigger location

when_to_avoid: Confirmation dialogs that need immediate response
performance_note: Longer duration justified by larger visual area

when_to_avoid: Secondary tooltips while first is open — skip animation and maintain delay
performance_note: Very short — must not delay information

when_to_use: Card grids and list items entering view
when_to_avoid: Lists with 10+ items — cap at 6-8 staggered items
performance_note: Split content into semantic chunks — stagger per chunk not per item

when_to_use: Elements leaving the viewport or closing
performance_note: Use small fixed translateY — never scale down on exit

when_to_use: Icon state changes (hamburger→X and toggle states)
Content blocks entering viewport on scroll
when_to_avoid: Above-the-fold content — never animate initial view
performance_note: Use IntersectionObserver — never scroll event listeners

when_to_use: Primary CTA button — one per page maximum
when_to_avoid: Secondary buttons or when page has >1 animated element
performance_note: Gentle glow breathing — not bouncing or scaling

when_to_avoid: Actions performed 100+ times daily (close tab and save and scroll and type)
performance_note: Animation fatigue — frequent actions must feel instant

css_example: Only animate transform and opacity properties
performance_note: Non-compositable properties trigger layout recalc — causes jank

css_example: Use ease-out or cubic-bezier for entries
when_to_avoid: ease-in feels sluggish on entry — only valid for exits
performance_note: ease-in accelerates INTO the screen which feels unnatural

css_example: Use scale(0.95) + opacity instead of scale(0)
when_to_avoid: Never animate from scale(0) — feels like a black hole
performance_note: scale(0.95) + opacity: 0 looks intentional — scale(0) looks broken

when_to_avoid: Modals (centre origin is fine for modals)
performance_note: Scale from the element that triggered the popover — not from centre

when_to_use: Interactive UI elements that user can re-trigger
performance_note: CSS transitions are interruptible — keyframes play to completion
